note: Shows blocks with a chart per step: each block adds one note, and its own neck lights exactly the notes named so far with Do lit from the first step to the last, ending on a tune that uses only those notes.

exercise.title: Do, Mi, Sol on the neck, one note at a time
exercise.focus: C major in open position · Do → Do Mi → Do Mi Sol → a tune
exercise.why: Knowing where Do, Mi and Sol sit around the open chords is the map for playing melodies by ear.

sections.text: Melodies are built on the home note and its chord, so learn them on the neck one at a time.
Play every {{1}} (C) in open position: the 3rd fret of the A string and the 1st fret of the B string. Back and forth, saying "Do" each time.
Add {{3}} (E). Play {{1}} then the nearest {{3}} above it, on both Cs: A string 3rd fret to D string 2nd fret, B string 1st fret to the open high E.
Add {{5}} (G), the open G string. Play {{1}} {{3}} {{5}} {{3}} {{1}} from the low C, slowly, then from memory with your eyes off the chart.
A short tune made of only those three notes: Do Mi Sol Mi Do. Press Play and play along in the neck view; then switch to tab and play it without the neck.
